items.title: Calvert-Lewin shows the way as Leeds thrash limp Newcastle and rise to third
items.summary: At what stage does a good start become something more significant? Perhaps we are not quite there yet; maybe we are. But as the goals flew in on a chaotic night at Elland Road, it was difficult not to think the boundaries of expectation for Leeds were potentially being redrawn. Ask those close to the action over the summer at Leeds and the feeling was that there was a possibility of something special materialising this season. Having found their feet in the Premier League in the last campaign, the platform had been set and a very good summer transfer window seemed like the catalyst for even brighter days to return to West Yorkshire. Continue reading...

items.title: Haaland goal should not have stood but VAR made the right call with Sunderland penalty | Chris Foy
items.summary: Matt Donohue is only human and made a mistake, but, in general, referees have started well this season There was a disappointing outcome on a big decision in the Manchester derby and no one will feel it more than the video assistant referee, Matt Donohue. On Sunday night, Pro Ref confirmed that Donohue had made a mistake in allowing Erling Haaland’s goal in City’s 1-0 victory to stand when Enzo Fernández had been in an offside position. When a VAR considers a decision such as this they start from the point at which the goal is scored and work backwards. Here, when Haaland scores, the flag is raised by the assistant referee for offside. The VAR automatically checked that on-field decision and used a semi‑automated system to show Haaland was onside. The decision was then made to overturn the call and award the goal. Continue reading...

items.title: Andoni Iraola tells Liverpool forwards they must do more to make his system work
items.summary: Head coach insists forwards need to improve pressing Changes up front likely for Carabao Cup tie against Spurs Andoni Iraola has shifted the focus on to Liverpool’s forwards for the team’s uninspiring display against Fulham, insisting they need to give more to make his system work. The head coach admitted his team took “a step backwards” with their goalless draw on Saturday. His central midfield pairing of Ryan Gravenberch and Dominik Szoboszlai struggled to contain their Fulham counterparts, winning two of five duels and one of nine duels respectively. But Iraola believes the problems started further forward with the pressing of Liverpool’s expensively assembled attack. Continue reading...

items.title: VARs who wrongly confirmed Haaland’s goal at Manchester United are stood down
items.summary: Matt Donohue and his assistant not used this weekend Pro Ref said allowing winner was ‘error of judgment’ The video assistant referee officials who allowed Erling Haaland’s winning goal in the Manchester derby on Sunday have been stood down. Matt Donohue and his assistant, Blake Antrobus, have been told by Pro Ref they have not received appointments for this weekend’s round of Premier League fixtures. Howard Webb, the chief ­refereeing officer, took the decision with his management team after a review of the weekend’s action. Their availa­bility will be reconsidered after the international break. Continue reading...

items.title: Deux ex-Mauves soulignent une évolution à Anderlecht : "Par rapport à la saison passée..."

Être capable de gagner ce genre de match, c'est peut-être ce qui différencie l'Anderlecht de cette saison de celui de la saison passée, pointent Silvio Proto et Steven Defour.

items.title: KRC Genk ontsnapt aan bijzonder nadeel tegen KAA Gent en Lardot begrijpt waarom

Tijdens Genk-Gent deed zich zondag een situatie voor die perfect blootlegde waar de huidige regelgeving kan wringen. Matte Smets en Josue Kongolo lagen op hetzelfde moment op het veld na problemen aan het hoofd, maar moesten niet allebei een minuut naar de kant.

items.title: Le KV Malines ne peut pas se plaindre : Jonathan Lardot analyse l'arbitrage du match contre Anderlecht
items.summary: Comme tous les lundis, Jonathan Lardot, le patron de l'arbitrage belge, a analysé les phases ayant fait polémique ce week-end en Jupiler Pro League. L'une de ces phases vient du match entre le KV Malines et le RSC Anderlecht, lors duquel les Sang & Or ont réclamé un penalty. Ils ne devaient pas en obtenir, selon Mr Lardot, qui estime cependant que Frederic Vanderbiest s'en est très bien sorti.
